name: f-couch2
prompt: She keeps reading her laptop, then lifts the mug and takes one small sip, lowers it, and her finger taps the trackpad once. She blinks and her smile softens a little. The dog in the background stays asleep; sunlight flickers gently through the plant. Locked-off tripod shot: the camera does not move at all. Small, ordinary movements at normal real-time speed, like candid documentary footage. The laptop stays in exactly the same place and its screen content stays sharp, still and unchanged. No text overlays, no logos.

name: f-react3

Small, ordinary movements at normal real-time speed, like candid documentary footage. The laptop stays in exactly the same place and its screen content stays sharp, still and unchanged.
